name: Romanian deadlift
summary: Weights in hand, hinge at the hips with soft knees until the hamstrings pull, then stand tall.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, weights in front of the thighs, knees soft. Push the hips back and let the weights slide down the legs, back flat, until the hamstrings pull. Drive the hips forward to stand.
brief: Stand with the weights in front of the thighs, knees soft. Push the hips back and let the weights slide down the legs, back flat, until the hamstrings pull.
why: From the side the shoulder–hip line hinges toward horizontal each rep, and the knees bending to turn it into a squat is caught by the knee angle.
regression: Bodyweight hip hinge with a dowel on the back.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Back rounding
faults.tip: Stop the descent when the back starts to round; chest proud, chin neutral.

faults.label: Weight drifting away from the legs
faults.tip: The weight stays in contact with the legs. Away from the body it becomes a back exercise.

faults.label: Weights drifting away from the legs
faults.tip: Drag the weights down the thighs; away from the body loads the lower back.

faults.label: Squatting instead of hinging
faults.tip: Knees stay softly bent and still. The hips travel backwards.

faults.label: Snapping the hips at the top
faults.cue: Stand tall, do not lean back
faults.tip: Finishing by leaning back hyperextends the lower back. Stop at upright.

guide.cannotSee: The back rounding under a shirt.

points.t: Travel back; trunk hinges toward level.
